## Skill Scope in Manus

**These skills are installed in the sandbox environment of this session only.** They are active and usable within this current task/conversation, but they do **not** automatically apply to your entire Manus account or future tasks.

### To make skills available account-wide (across all tasks):

The skill cards attached in my previous message are the key. Each `.skill` file attachment has three options when you click on it in the Manus UI:

1. **"Add to My Skills"** — This saves the skill to your Manus account settings, making it available in **all future tasks**
2. **"Download"** — Downloads the skill file locally
3. **"Preview"** — View the skill content

### Summary

| Scope | How |
|-------|-----|

| All future tasks (account-wide) | Click **"Add to My Skills"** on each skill card above |
